text: Equity indices across Asia register synchronized declines; trading halts activate. Oil benchmarks fluctuate at elevated levels while flow through Hormuz remains constrained. Public designation of energy and financial infrastructure as targets is stated. Gold and silver decline alongside rising rate expectations. Forecasts adjust upward for crude.

meta.note: Gold decline under conflict conditions introduces cross-asset divergence within compression regime.

text: Crude benchmarks decline ~6% following announced pause on infrastructure strikes. Hormuz flow remains constrained with no confirmed reopening. Price forecasts stay elevated while strategic reserves remain engaged. Infrastructure targeting designation persists despite temporary halt.

meta.note: Price decline occurs without restoration of flow capacity, indicating partial decoupling between constraint and pricing.
